metadata.title: Vehicle Data and Dealer SaaS Platform Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog of RDW-derived vehicle facts, partner history data, market and valuation data, dealer and trade operations, and accounts/governance, with RDW provider, partner-licence, GDPR and fiscal governance.

assets.name: Vehicle Registration Record
assets.description: RDW-derived registration, technical, APK, WOK and status facts per plate, with change history.
assets.businessMeaning: What the authority knows about the vehicle.

interfaces.name: register-changed
interfaces.description: Ownership, APK, WOK and export mutations.

interfaces.name: register extract
interfaces.description: Licensed batch extracts for enrichment and insights.

governance.sharingPolicy: Only for licensed purposes under RDW provider terms; owner identity never exposed to consumers.

assets.name: Vehicle Specification
assets.description: Normalised make, model, edition, options, emissions and prices with source lineage.
assets.businessMeaning: Exactly which vehicle it is.

interfaces.name: specification api
interfaces.description: Normalised edition and options by plate or VIN.

interfaces.name: partner catalog import
interfaces.description: Autotelex and Jato model and price feeds.

governance.sharingPolicy: Per partner licence (DAT, Autotelex, Jato).

assets.name: Damage History
assets.description: International damage events from insurers and the damage trade, WOK status and BPM changes per VIN.
assets.businessMeaning: What damage the vehicle had.

interfaces.name: damage history api
interfaces.description: Damage report by plate or VIN.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Maintenance History
assets.description: Manufacturer service records per VIN.
assets.businessMeaning: Whether the car was maintained.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Odometer Reading and Judgement
assets.description: NAP odometer judgement (logical/illogical) and readings.
assets.businessMeaning: Whether the mileage is credible.

interfaces.name: odometer judgement api
interfaces.description: NAP judgement and readings by plate.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: EV Battery Health Report
assets.description: Battery state-of-health measurements and certificates.
assets.businessMeaning: How healthy the EV battery is.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Damage Calculation
assets.description: Repair estimates with photos, parts and labour.
assets.businessMeaning: What repairing the damage costs.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Market Advertisement Observation
assets.description: Observed national and international adverts with price, mileage and stand-time.
assets.businessMeaning: What comparable cars are offered for.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Vehicle Transaction History
assets.description: Ownership changes and sales events over 30+ years.
assets.businessMeaning: When and how often cars change hands.

governance.sharingPolicy: Aggregated outputs only.

assets.name: Market Insight Dataset
assets.description: Aggregated registrations, sales and shares by brand, model, dealer and region.
assets.businessMeaning: How the market and each dealer perform.

governance.sharingPolicy: Aggregated, client-specific scopes.

assets.name: Ownership Change Score
assets.description: Probability that a vehicle changes owner in 1–2 months.
assets.businessMeaning: Who is likely to be in the market soon.

governance.sharingPolicy: Only under documented purpose and opt-out rules.

assets.name: Valuation Record
assets.description: Issued valuations with inputs and model version.
assets.businessMeaning: What the car was worth when valued.

interfaces.name: valuation api
interfaces.description: Retail, trade and maximum purchase values.

interfaces.name: valuation-issued
interfaces.description: For accuracy tracking against realised sales.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: BPM Calculation and Taxation Report
assets.description: BPM and remaining-BPM calculations and signed taxation reports.
assets.businessMeaning: What registration tax applies.

interfaces.name: taxation report
interfaces.description: Signed report filed with the Tax Authority.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Purchase Appraisal Report
assets.description: Trade-in appraisals with photos, condition and offer.
assets.businessMeaning: Why the dealer offered this price.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

rootGroups.name: Dealer and Trade Operations
rootGroups.description: Data created while dealers and traders work.

assets.name: Vehicle Dossier
assets.description: Dealer dossier with timeline, documents and actions per vehicle.
assets.businessMeaning: Everything the dealer did with this car.

interfaces.name: dossier-timeline
interfaces.description: Actions recorded on the vehicle timeline.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Dealer Stock Item
assets.description: Stock with cost, target margin, prices and signals.
assets.businessMeaning: What the dealer owns and at what margin.

interfaces.name: stock-changed
interfaces.description: Triggers advert updates and trade listings.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Advertisement Listing
assets.description: Adverts and channel delivery status.
assets.businessMeaning: Where each car is advertised.

governance.sharingPolicy: Published to channels.

assets.name: Sales Lead
assets.description: Enquiries from websites and portals.
assets.businessMeaning: Who is interested in which car.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Sales Document
assets.description: Quotes, purchase agreements and invoices.
assets.businessMeaning: The legal record of a sale.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Financing Application
assets.description: Financing quotes and applications handed to the lender.
assets.businessMeaning: Which buyer applied for credit.

interfaces.name: finance api
interfaces.description: Quotes and application status with the lender.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with the financing partner only.

assets.name: RDW Transaction Record
assets.description: Submitted RDW transactions with responses and proof.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof of official registration actions.

interfaces.name: proof document
interfaces.description: RDW proof for seller and buyer.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Import/Export Document
assets.description: EAD, VKR, type approval declarations and foreign registration letters.
assets.businessMeaning: Legal cross-border paperwork.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Trade Offer
assets.description: Trade listings, offers and deals between professionals.
assets.businessMeaning: Who offered what to whom.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Webshop Order
assets.description: Trade and consumer orders for plates, stickers, vignettes and insurance.
assets.businessMeaning: What was ordered and delivered.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Enrichment Batch
assets.description: Client plate files and enriched results.
assets.businessMeaning: Which records a client enriched.

interfaces.name: plate file upload and result
interfaces.description: Client plate sets in, enriched files out.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Consumer Vehicle Report
assets.description: Purchased Finnik reports and receipts.
assets.businessMeaning: What a consumer learned about a car.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Customer Account
assets.description: Companies, branches, users, roles, subscriptions and RDW authorisations.
assets.businessMeaning: Who the customer is and what they may do.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Subscription and Usage Ledger
assets.description: Subscriptions, billable events and invoices.
assets.businessMeaning: What each customer owes.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

assets.name: Data Licence and Consent Register
assets.description: Source licences, client purposes and the access audit log.
assets.businessMeaning: Whether a data use is allowed and who did what.

interfaces.name: licence check api
interfaces.description: Allow or deny a request by client, purpose and source.

governance.sharingPolicy: Internal; customers see their own data.

stores.name: Vehicle Register DB
stores.description: Plate-keyed RDW register mirror, specifications and history events.

stores.name: RDW Register Cache
stores.description: Short-lived cache of RDW lookups with freshness flags so plate lookups survive RDW slowness.

stores.name: Partner Data Mirror
stores.description: Licensed copies and caches of partner sources (DAT, Autotelex, Jato, damage and maintenance providers) with source lineage.

stores.name: Vehicle and Business Events
stores.description: Event topics for register changes, valuations, stock changes, transactions, orders and usage.

stores.name: Market Data Raw Zone
stores.description: Landing zone for daily advert harvests, ownership-change feeds and partner files before matching.

stores.name: Market Data Warehouse
stores.description: Adverts, ownership changes, transactions, valuations and insight cubes.

stores.name: Valuation Model Registry
stores.description: Versioned depreciation curves, option values, scoring models and their back-test results.

stores.name: Dealer Operations DB
stores.description: Dossiers, stock, adverts, leads, sales documents and appraisals per dealer tenant.

stores.name: Stock Search Index
stores.description: Searchable projection of dealer stock and adverts for dealer websites and the trade market.

stores.name: Transactions and Trade DB
stores.description: RDW transactions, BPM cases, trade documents, trade offers and orders.

stores.name: Identity Directory
stores.description: Companies, branches, users, roles, module entitlements and RDW authorisations.

stores.name: Billing Ledger DB
stores.description: Subscriptions, rated usage events and invoices.

stores.name: Document and Photo Store
stores.description: Reports, photos, PDFs, certificates and client files.

stores.name: Client File Exchange
stores.description: Secure upload and download area for enrichment files, lead lists and custom data files.

stores.name: Compliance Audit Log
stores.description: Immutable data-access audit trail and licence register.

stores.name: Fiscal and Legal Archive
stores.description: Write-once archive for records with statutory retention (sales, tax, transactions, invoices).
